create_submission.description: Record a submission against a form without going through the form itself: useful for importing responses collected elsewhere.
create_submission.display_str_template: Create a Fillout submission for form '{0}'.

scheduling.meeting_notes: Wants a demo of the reporting tab.
scheduling.name: Pick a time

create_submission.name: create_submission

parameters.description: The ID of the form, as returned by List forms. It's also the last part of the form's public URL.
parameters.name: form_id

parameters.description: The answers to record, keyed by question ID -- for example {"kj4Q": "Ada Lovelace"}. Use Get a form to look up the question IDs.
parameters.name: answers

parameters.description: Optional. Tracking values to record alongside the answers, keyed by URL parameter ID -- for example {"utm_source": "newsletter"}. Use Get a form to look up the IDs.
parameters.name: url_parameters

parameters.description: Optional. When the response was originally collected. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: submitted_at

parameters.description: Optional. When the response was last changed. Defaults to the submitted time.
parameters.name: last_updated_at

answers.description: The answers keyed by question text -- for example {'Email': 'ada@example.com'}. The quickest way to read one known answer.

calculations.description: What the form's calculations worked out for this submission

value.description: What the calculation worked out for this submission

edit_link.description: A link that reopens this submission for editing. Empty unless the action was asked to include it.

last_updated_at.description: When the submission was last changed

login_email.description: The verified email address, when the form is behind a login page

payments.description: Payments taken through the form's Fillout Payments fields

currency.description: The currency the charge was in

email.description: The email the payment was made with

payment_status.description: Where the payment got to, as Stripe reports it

stripe_customer_url.description: Link to the customer in the Stripe dashboard

stripe_payment_url.description: Link to the payment in the Stripe dashboard

stripe_subscription_id.description: The Stripe subscription's ID, for a recurring payment

total_amount.description: How much was charged, in the currency's smallest unit (cents)

questions.description: Every answer in form order, with the question IDs needed to write a submission back

name.description: The question text shown on the form

question_id.description: The question's ID. Use with Create a submission.

type.description: The kind of question, for example 'ShortAnswer', 'EmailInput', or 'MultipleChoice'

quiz_max_score.description: The highest score the quiz can award

quiz_score.description: The score this submission earned, when the form is a quiz

scheduling.description: Meetings booked through the form's Fillout Scheduling fields

reschedule_or_cancel_url.description: Link the booker can use to reschedule or cancel

scheduled_user_email.description: The host the meeting was booked with

timezone.description: The timezone the slot was booked in

submission_id.description: Submission ID. Use with Get a submission.

url_parameters.description: The URL parameters the form was opened with -- where a tracking code such as utm_source arrives

parameter_id.description: The URL parameter's ID. Use with Create a submission's URL parameters.

value.description: The value the form was opened with

create_webhook.description: Subscribe a URL to a form's new submissions. Fillout POSTs each new response to it in the same shape List submissions returns.
create_webhook.display_str_template: Create a Fillout webhook for form '{0}'.
create_webhook.name: create_webhook

parameters.description: The ID of the form, as returned by List forms. It's also the last part of the form's public URL.
parameters.name: form_id

parameters.description: The HTTPS endpoint Fillout should POST each new submission to.
parameters.name: url

form_id.description: The form the webhook listens to

url.description: The endpoint submissions are sent to

webhook_id.description: Webhook ID. Use with Remove a webhook.

delete_submission.description: Permanently delete one submission from a form. This cannot be undone, and the response stops counting toward the form's results.
delete_submission.name: delete_submission

parameters.description: The ID of the form, as returned by List forms. It's also the last part of the form's public URL.
parameters.name: form_id

parameters.description: The ID of the submission, as returned by List submissions or Create a submission.
parameters.name: submission_id

deleted.description: True once Fillout has removed the submission

form_id.description: The form the submission was deleted from

delete_webhook.description: Stop a webhook from receiving submissions, using the ID Create a webhook returned.
delete_webhook.name: delete_webhook

parameters.description: The ID of the webhook to remove, as returned by Create a webhook.
parameters.name: webhook_id

deleted.description: True once Fillout has removed the webhook
